## Scope

Describe the mechanism, interface, or research question changed here.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] `ruff check src tests tools` passes.
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes from the repository root.
- [ ] Configuration and seed contracts are recorded for result changes.

## Research integrity

- [ ] Frozen test incidents were not used for calibration.
- [ ] New physical or operational assumptions have a cited source or are
      explicitly marked as research assumptions.
- [ ] Claims are bounded by the evaluated incident set and baselines.
- [ ] Large/generated artifacts follow the repository artifact policy.
